settings.subtitle: Our Story
settings.title: Purity Meets Science
settings.description: Founded in 2018, we set out with a simple mission: create skincare that works without compromising your health or the planet. Every formula is crafted with certified organic ingredients and backed by scientific research.

settings.title: 100% Organic
settings.description: Every ingredient is certified organic and sourced from sustainable farms around the world.

settings.title: Science-Backed
settings.description: Our formulas are developed by cosmetic chemists and tested for efficacy.

settings.title: Cruelty-Free
settings.description: We never test on animals. All our products are Leaping Bunny certified.

settings.title: Eco-Conscious
settings.description: Carbon-neutral operations and 100% recyclable packaging materials.

settings.title: The Beginning
settings.description: Founded in a small kitchen with a passion for clean beauty and a vision to transform the skincare industry.

settings.title: First Product Launch
settings.description: Released our signature Vitamin C Serum, which quickly became a customer favorite and industry bestseller.

settings.title: Going Carbon Neutral
settings.description: Achieved carbon-neutral certification and switched to 100% recyclable packaging materials.

settings.title: 100,000 Happy Customers
settings.description: Reached a major milestone with over 100,000 customers trusting us with their skincare routine.

settings.title: Global Expansion
settings.description: Expanded to 30+ countries, bringing clean organic skincare to customers worldwide.

settings.subtitle: Our Team
